cohort: The study cohort comprises women who participated in Demographic and Health Surveys in Cambodia across multiple years.
finding: The overall C-section rate in Cambodia rose to 15.5% by 2021, primarily driven by private facilities where rates surged to 48.1% and were significantly higher among wealthier economic groups.
mod_finding: C-section utilization in public facilities increased from 5.1% in 2010 to 9.7% in 2021, consistently higher in urban areas, while private facility C-section rates reached 48.1% in 2021, with urban and rural rates at 50.5% and 45.7% respectively, predominantly among the richest and richer groups.
